definition: A role is covered only when a task-relevant exact NumStability witness occurs in the final elaborated L statement or kernel-checked proof term. An import, textual mention, or transitive-only dependency is not evidence. Three roles per task make the score a 0-3 breadth index, not an estimate of Lean lines saved or causal library coverage.

roles.foundation: Source-relevant numeric domain, floating-point model, gamma, or norm interface
roles.computation: Source-relevant algorithm, rounding operation, tree, or task-domain error-functional interface
roles.analysis: Source-relevant proved error/bound or mathematical bridge used in the proof
